title: Facet load share at lumbar (variable) - Yang KH, King A 1984 (Spine 9:557) (secondary, Ghezelbash 2020 review)

quantity.name: facet load share
quantity.definition: % of compression transmitted via both facets (intervertebral load cell), mean +/- SD

source.authors: Ghezelbash F, Schmidt H, Shirazi-Adl A, El-Rich M
source.sample: not stated in review (see primary: Yang KH, King A 1984 (Spine 9:557)); human cadaveric lumbar specimens of Yang KH, King A 1984 (Spine 9:557), as compiled in Ghezelbash et al. 2020 Table 2

protocol.summary: Eccentric compression 1.1 kN; intervertebral load cell.
how_to_simulate: Apply 1.1 kN compression centrally or 10 mm anterior/posterior eccentric
protocol.notes: Secondary data compiled in a review (Ghezelbash et al.'s review). Sample size, specimen age, rate and cycles are not given in the review; use the primary paper for these. Primary source: Yang KH, King A 1984 (Spine 9:557).

extraction.from: Table 2 (summary of in vitro facet force measurements)
extraction.check_notes: Re-read against the rendered Table 2 image (page 5, 200 dpi): every value, +/-, min/max, units and level labels match the pdftotext output. | 2026-11-12: source.n was the primary paper year (1984); primary n not available here, set to null.

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 1 SD (mean+/-SD) or min <= model <= max (ranges); widen for facet-force method bias (Wilson 2006)
